readiness_policy.meaning: Equal-weight acceptance-gate completion, not lines of code, time remaining, probability of success or demonstrated task mastery. Different experiments have different applicable gates.
readiness_policy.ready_for_use_rule: All applicable software gates must PASS, including canonical vertical path and current release qualification. Component tests never alone imply SOFTWARE READY. Physical readiness requires its separate observed tests.
readiness_policy.evidence_scope: Existing scoped evidence only; no new broad audit of parked 04/05/06. Historical live release and later main remain distinct.
readiness_policy.physical_01_scope: Optional physical deployment only; autonomous SIM use does not require movement of a real robot.
